item.title: Wednesday Short Cuts
item.description: Notable quotables from Mark Kelly, Tim Walz, JD Vance, Mark Alexander, Joshua Arnold, Gary Bauer, Douglas Adams, and more.

item.title: The Anti-American Left
item.description: Time and time again, Democrats rally around our enemies, foreign and domestic, that are trying to bring America down.

item.title: Is Scott Adams Finding Jesus?
item.description: The popular Dilbert cartoonist is dying of terminal cancer, but has recently announced he is embracing the Christian theory.

item.title: California's One-Party Government Isn't Aging Well
item.description: It wasn't that long ago that the Golden State was viewed as a model of the future for the rest of the country. That's changing rapidly.

item.title: The Palisades Fire One Year Later
item.description: Now that we're a full year beyond the disastrous wildfire in Southern California, not much has changed for struggling residents.

item.title: Hilton Hotel Causes ICE Storm
item.description: The backlash after a hotel's apparent ban against DHS agents staying there reveals the sometimes high cost of political posturing.

item.title: Goodbye, Tim Walz
item.description: It's not a resignation, but the Left's favorite Midwestern dad is at least dropping out of the Minnesota governor's race due to an epic fraud scandal under his watch.

item.title: Wednesday Executive News Summary
item.description: Conservative titan Michael Reagan dies, Georgia sets special election to replace MTG, Pentagon considers role of military women, and more.

item.title: Trump Still Desires a Greenland New Deal
item.description: The American president wants to bolster U.S. national security, obtain greater access to valuable resources, and oust old Europe from the Western Hemisphere.

item.title: 250 Years of American Liberty, With a Heart of Gratitude
item.description: "Live each day to the fullest. Live each day with enthusiasm, optimism, and hope."
